subject: How to include files when deploying an application

messages.author: b48728584f437b83
messages.subject: How to include files when deploying an application
parts:
Hi,

I try to deploy an application which uses two kind of files :
a call inside server.R with source({flle1 = the name of a R file which include some functions})
a call inside server.R with load({file2 = the name of a R data file})

How can I proceed to include my files (file1 and file2) when deploying my application ?

Thank you very much !
Dominique

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to include files when deploying an application
parts:
Dominique,

Thanks for taking the time to try out the ShinyApps alpha. We really appreciate the help!

Any file that is part of your application will be uploaded to the ShinyApps service, and can be accessed from your ui.R or server.R files as you normally would with shiny or shiny-server. All files in the directory specified as the appDir parameter of deployApp() are considered to be part of the application. The appDir parameter defaults to the current working directory.

For example if you wanted to source a file called "functions.R", you would call source('functions.R') from server.R file. When you call deployApp(), all the files in the current directory will be uploaded and functions.R will be sourced when the application is finished being deployed. If you have tried this and seem to be having issues, please let us know.

I hope that helps, and feel free to reach out if you have further questions.

-Andy
